messages:
maya (new-hire): Hi all, I'm Maya and my first on-call rotation is next week. Quick checks: 1) runbook access 2) pager routing on my phone 3) where to find the incident playbook template.
leo (oncall-lead): Welcome Maya! Runbooks = Confluence > Reliability > Oncall Runbooks. If you don't have access, say your SSO email and @kevin will add you. Pager routing: we use OpsGenie -> phone + SMS by default. Check OpsGenie profile and enable SMS. Incident template is in the runbook, section 'Incident Lifecycle' -> 'Template & Exec Notice'.
kevin (sre): Adding now. What's your SSO?
maya (new-hire): maya@redwood.com
kevin (sre): Added. Should be able to view now. If not, logout/login.
devx-bot: Heads-up: New oncall orientation recording & slides uploaded: https://drive/reliability/oncall-orientation.mp4
sam (eng-manager): Two practical pointers: - When you ack a page, update Slack with one sentence: what you see and next action. - If there's any customer impact, assign a severity immediately and notify the oncall-lead.
maya (new-hire): Re: phone routing 4f1 4f2 I enabled SMS but test page fails. Error: "delivery blocked" on OpsGenie test. Anyone seen SMS blocked?
kevin (sre): Carrier blocks sometimes for new numbers. Try enabling push notifications in OpsGenie mobile app. Also check that your phone number doesn't have country code mismatch.
maya (new-hire): Push notifications enabled; still no test page. I restarted the app and now I got the push.
leo (oncall-lead): Good. One more: shadow policy for first two rotations. You'll be paired with Leo for first night and Sam for second night. Pagerbot will schedule shadows automatically.
maya (new-hire): Thanks, appreciate the help. Can someone point me to the small checklist for initial response steps?
leo (oncall-lead): It's the 'pager triage checklist' at the top of runbook. Quick steps: 1) Acknowledge 2) Determine impact 3) Identify if it's routing/infra/app 4) Run quick health checks (links in checklist) 5) If unsure, escalate to oncall-lead.
maya (new-hire): Got it. One weird quirk: runbook links open but the exec contact table shows empty.
kevin (sre): That's the Confluence macro not expanding for new viewers. Should be fixed now. Try refresh.
maya (new-hire): Looks good now.
pagerbot: Scheduled: Maya shadow with Leo  2026-03-29 22:30-06:30 UTC.
maya (new-hire): Thanks! Excited to learn :smile:
